scope: Live macOS IORegistry arrival/removal notifications during user-performed ordinary power-on; not a USB packet capture or internal boot log.

current_registry_corroboration.source: Separate cached registry read after user reported completion; no interface open.

user_report.screen: USB text and USB icon; no other unusual behavior reported

observer_stop: Explicit SIGINT to exact owned command; exec session confirmed exit code 130; capture flushed after each event.
conclusion: One normal-mode device arrival observed; no intermediate identity or removal/rearrival observed in the captured registry events.
limits: No exact user-action timestamps; elapsed_s is time since observer start, not camera boot duration.
Only devices published as IOUSBHostDevice are observed; earlier electrical activity or failed/unpublished enumeration is outside coverage.
No internal register capture, boot log or independent recovery evidence.
Observer sends no USB/PTP/vendor commands; ordinary macOS enumeration/framework traffic is separate and unmeasured.
Other-device baseline identities and raw serial strings are excluded from this summary.
